title: Evaluation of Reliability Criteria for News Publishers with Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the LLM's ability to detect the degree of journalistic bias in news articles (the 'Article bias' criterion) by comparing its zero-shot classifications (e.g., Biased vs. Unbiased) against ground-truth annotations from human experts.

Assessing the LLM's capability to identify if a news article negatively targets specific individuals or groups based on political issues, using prompts aligned with the Global Disinformation Index (GDI) criteria and comparing results to human annotators.

Assessing the LLM's capability to identify if a news article negatively targets specific individuals or groups based on gender, using GDI-aligned prompts and comparing the model's extraction to human expert consensus.

Assessing the LLM's capability to identify if a news article negatively targets specific individuals or groups based on religion, comparing the LLM's zero-shot annotations against human expert evaluations.
